decisions.statement: An emitter fires only after the interval passes with nothing sent.
An emitter that is never stopped fires for the life of the process.
A stopped emitter is stopped for good.
A caller that opens an emitter closes that emitter on every path the stream can end by.
Nothing here knows the frames a stream has.
The timers are handed in so a test needs no clock.

definition: a comment sent down a quiet stream so the reader knows it is still there
